question: Related Questions Q. This is farooq, After eating camel meet and after drinking camel milk we have to do gusul compulsary? 2333 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 69854 Country: India Title: Is eating poppy seeds halal or haram? Question: Can you please tell me whether eating poppy seeds (posta dana or khas-khas) is halal or haram? Answer ID: 69854 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1486/1500/L=1/1438) It is allowable to eat poppy seeds provided it does not reach to the extent of intoxication. (Fatwa Darul Uloom, vol. 16, p. 66) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
